releases.body:
### OpenCode 2 Support & Major Improvements

- Full compatibility with OpenCode 2 plugin architecture
- Streaming response rewriting with Unicode BiDi isolation
- Preserves code blocks, tables, and formatting markers
- Auto-detection for 10+ RTL languages (Arabic, Persian, Hebrew, Urdu, Kurdish, etc.)
- Available on npm: `npm install opencode-rtl@1.0.0`
